desc: 冷调深蓝信息图套图，图标卖点、撕口与叠层双栏对照、规格阶梯与整箱到货收口
name: 大卷压花家庭装卷纸款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清提装轮廓与卷层排布，抢住点击。
一秒给出核心主张，用三个空白图标位承接后续卖点。
shots.textZone: 右侧 45% 三枚空白图标位，各配一行短标「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 把撕不干净、纸页软垂的日常烦躁摆到眼前，制造替换动机。
用双手环抱的真实手感交代厚实度，让买家把自己代入。
同机位双栏呈现两种撕口结果，不靠任何主张也说清差别。
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 留白供一行主张「{selling_point_1}」，两栏内不出现品牌或标签

shots.intent: 微距交代压花凸起与纤维厚度，用放大镜代替任何参数。
用两叠纸页的真实高度差讲清厚实与回弹，替代任何数据主张。
shots.textZone: 顶部 25% 留白供「{selling_point_2}」，两栏底部空白标签位各供「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 把可选卷径摆在同一尺度里，替买家完成选款并降低退货。
shots.textZone: 右侧 30% 三个空白圆角标签位，各供一行「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」

shots.intent: 提前告知同款可能到手的两种包装外观，避免收货落差与差评。
shots.textZone: 顶部 22% 留白供一行说明「{callout_9}」，两包下方标签位保持空白

shots.intent: 展示外箱开启后的整批到货状态，消除运输与囤货顾虑并收束全页。

style.backgroundSystem: one seamless cool studio cyclorama #F2F5F9 for packshots, one deep field #14357C meeting a sky tabletop #6EC6F2 for infographic screens, and three graduated pale panels #E8EDF3 / #C9DCEE / #9FBEDC for pain-point and hand-feel screens; no other background is allowed
style.direction: clean premium paper-goods commerce on a cool high-key studio system
style.iconSystem: flat hairline pictograms inside empty circular plates in #FFFFFF on the deep field, uniform stroke weight, at most one #E0357E accent per screen
style.lightingSystem: broad even high-key key from the front-left at 5000-5600K with a large fill card opposite, soft-to-medium contact shadow directly under every object, low skimming side light only inside macro screens, no hard speculars and no colored gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean premium paper-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep ink field #14357C, sky tabletop #6EC6F2, snow body surface #FFFFFF and one magenta accent #E0357E over graduated cool panels #F2F5F9 / #E8EDF3 / #C9DCEE / #9FBEDC; cool high-key studio lighting, broad front-left key with large fill, soft honest contact shadows, skimming side light only in macro screens; one modern geometric sans-serif family with headline over hairline dividers; flat hairline pictograms inside empty circular plates, single accent only; matte paper-goods surfaces plus one kraft corrugated carton interior; stable upright pack placement and identical scale across paired panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no brand name, wordmark, slogan or character mascot graphic
no roll-count, sheet-count, pack-count or yardage numerals
no softer-than, absorbs-X-times or one-roll-equals-N-rolls comparison claims
no certification marks, forest or quality seals, URLs or store badges
no recognizable face or identifiable model styling
no invented lab data, ratings or testimonials
style.presentationRules: carry-pack always upright with a real contact shadow and nothing cropped, loose rolls standing on a flat base with the core opening visible, identical camera distance and light on both panels of any comparison, one consistent 3/4 reading angle for the pack across the whole set
style.surfaceSystem: matte laminated paper-goods surface, loose sheets with real embossed relief, and one kraft corrugated carton interior #B4884F as the only prop surface; no marble, no wood grain, no textile drape
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family, headline above a hairline divider, at most three short labels per screen, no serif, no script, no cartoon lettering
